newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra simplifies resident re-entry visas.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra simplifies resident re-entry visas.

text.p: Australia on Friday announced it would simplify return visas for permanent residents.
Immigration Minister Philip Ruddock said in a statement permanent residents could apply for a five-year return resident visa if they had been in Australia for two of the past five years.

"There will no longer be a requirement to assess whether or not a person has been 'usually resident' in Australia," he said. Permanent residents who are not Australian citizens need a return visa to re-enter Australia if they travel overseas.
